content.what_it_is: FUNWAVE-TVD (GPU repo, CPU-side) sample initial/boundary condition generators (Simplified BSD header L1-44, header comment L3 'FILE sample.F'). SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY (L56-83, input.txt 'SOL' per L50): on the west-boundary rank (MPI_PROC_NULL guard L62-64) imposes a time-dependent solitary Eta at I=Ibeg: c1=sqrt(GRAV*h00*(1+aa/h00)) (L68), zz=aa/COSH(tex*(Lag_soli-c1*TIME))**2 (L72), H=Eta+Depth (L74); comments L75-77 note U/HU cannot be prescribed at the boundary for dispersive equations. INITIAL_WAVE (L95-160, 'INI'): builds xx/yy grids (L104-114) then contains box (L124-131), dam-break (L136-141), commented gaussian (L143-145) and alongshore-crest (L149-157) initializations, all skipped by goto 200/100/213 (L123, L135, L150) -- effectively dead code. INITIAL_RECTANGULAR (L173/L175 variants, 'INI_REC', L163-245): sets Eta=AMP inside index window Il:Ir,Jl:Jr computed from Xc/Yc/WID with ghost offset; parallel version uses iista/jjsta subdomain offsets (L202-205 CARTESIAN, L213-216 spherical; ykchoi Jan/23/2018 replacement of npx*Mglob/px commented L198-201, L209-212) with window clipping L220-227; serial version L231-242. INITIAL_GAUSIAN (L258/L260, L248-334): Eta=AMP*EXP(-r**2/1.0_SP/WID**2) (L292 etc) with r from physical coordinates xr,yr; four preprocessor variants (PARALLEL x CARTESIAN). INITIAL_DIPOLE (L347/L349, 'INI_DIP', L337-427): Eta=AMP*uni*EXP(-r**2/1.0_SP/WID**2+0.5_SP) with uni=-1.414_SP/WID*(xr-Xc) (L381-382 etc). INITIAL_N_WAVE (L439-499, 'N_WAVE'): isosceles N-wave Eta=a0*COSH(gamma*(tmp1-x1))**(-2)*tanh(gamma*(tmp1-x1)) (L492) with a0,gamma per Synolakis (A15) refs (L459-463); U=SQRT(GRAV/dep)*Eta (L493), V=0; STOP if dep==ZERO (L455-458); general N-wave form commented (L489-490). INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE (L511-571, 'SOL'): hardcodes alpha=-0.39 (L534; formula from Beta commented L531 with mismatch note L532-533), calls SUB_SLTRY (L536) then Eta=A1*SC*SC+A2*SC**4 (L560), U=+/-A*SC*SC by SolitaryPositiveDirection (L561-565), SC=1/COSH(B*(I-Xwavemaker/DX-1)*DX) with parallel iista offset (L545/L548/L554/L557). SUB_SLTRY (L582-634): solitary-wave solution of 'Nogu' (Nwogu) equations -- builds cubic x**3+p*x**2+q*x+r=0 coefficients (L594-600), Newton-Raphson from x=1.2_SP with max 10 iterations else stop (L603-614), then celerity r1=C_ph=rx*cph (L615-618) and profile coefficients au,bue,ae1,ae2 (L627-631). No file I/O (all WRITE/print commented). Data blocks: none (source code).
entities: SUBROUTINE SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY @L56; REAL(SP):: aa,h00,c1,tex,tlag,zz @L59; INTEGER::Iwavemaker @L60; end @L83
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_WAVE @L95; REAL(SP),Dimension(Mloc,Nloc)::XX,YY @L98; REAL(SP):: sigma,x_c,y_c,a,r @L99; INTEGER :: ii1,ii2 @L100; end @L160

SUBROUTINE INITIAL_RECTANGULAR(M,N,Nghost,DX,DY,Xc,Yc,WID,AMP,Eta) @L173 (CARTESIAN) / (M,N,Nghost,Dphi,Dtheta,Lon_West,Lat_South,Xc,Yc,WID,AMP,Eta) @L175-176; USE GLOBAL ONLY npx,npy,px,py,Mglob,Nglob,myid,iista,jjsta @L180-181 (PARALLEL/MGPU); M,N,Nghost @L184; DX,DY,Xc,Yc,WID,AMP @L186 / spherical @L188; Eta OUT @L190; Il,Jl,Ir,Jr @L191; end @L245
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_GAUSIAN(...) @L258 (CARTESIAN) / @L260-261; USE GLOBAL @L265-266; M,N,Nghost @L269; reals @L271/L273; Eta OUT @L275; Il,Jl,Ir,Jr @L276; r,xr,yr @L277; end @L334
SUBROUTINE INITIAL_DIPOLE(...) @L347 (CARTESIAN) / @L349-350; USE GLOBAL @L354-355; M,N,Nghost @L358; reals @L360/L362; Eta OUT @L364; Il,Jl,Ir,Jr @L365; r,xr,yr,uni @L366; end @L427

SUBROUTINE INITIAL_N_WAVE(M,N,DX,x1,x2,Ha,gamma_s,dep,U,V,Eta) @L439; USE GLOBAL only npx,px,Mglob,iista @L441-442; M,N @L446; x1,x2,Ha,gamma_s,dep @L447; a0,gamma @L448; DX @L450 (CARTESIAN scalar) / @L452 (array); U,V,Eta OUT @L454; end @L499

SUBROUTINE INITIAL_SOLITARY_WAVE(M,N,DX,Xwavemaker,AMP_Soli,Dep_Soli,Beta,U,V,Eta,SolitaryPositiveDirection) @L511-512; USE GLOBAL @L515-516; M,N @L519; DX @L521/L523; Dep_Soli,Xwavemaker,Beta @L525; U,V,Eta OUT @L526; AMP_Soli @L527; A,B,A1,A2,alpha,SC,Cph,C_ph @L528; LOGICAL SolitaryPositiveDirection @L529; end @L571

SUBROUTINE SUB_SLTRY(a0, h1, alp, r1, bue, ae1, ae2, au, C_ph) @L582; IN a0,h1,alp @L585; OUT r1,bue,ae1,ae2,au,C_ph @L586; locals alp2,p,q,r,x,fx,fpx,rx,cph,eps,zr,g @L587; INTEGER ite @L588; end @L634

equations.ref: rectangular hump fill, parallel branch (also L242 serial)

calls: SUB_SLTRY: stop @L612 (Newton non-convergence after 10 iterations); goto 1 @L614

verbatim_spans.text: !    it can be specified in input.txt giving 'SOL'
! note: can not provide u and hu at boundary for dispersive equations!
!    it can be specified in input.txt giving 'INI_REC'
! recalculate a0 and gamma based on Synolakis etal (A15)
! something wrong here. if beta=-0.531, then alpha should be -0.39
!    SUB_SLTRY is subroutine to provide solitary wave solution of Nogu equations

unresolved: INITIAL_WAVE (L95-160) is effectively dead code: goto 200 (L123), goto 100 (L135) and goto 213 (L150) skip the box (L124-131), dam-break (L136-141) and alongshore-crest (L151-157) blocks, and the gaussian is commented (L144-145), so Eta is never modified; sigma/x_c/y_c/a (L116-119) and XX/YY (L104-114) are computed but unused.

tmp1/tmp2 used in INITIAL_WAVE (L125-127) and tmp1 in INITIAL_N_WAVE (L473-486) are not locally declared despite IMPLICIT NONE -- must be module variables from USE GLOBAL/PARAM; same for loop indices I,J in the INTENT-based subroutines (e.g. L283-284, L466-467).

alpha=-0.39 hardcoded (L534) replaces the commented formula alpha=0.5_SP*Beta*Beta+Beta (L531); comments L532-533 record that the resulting wave shape does not match the equation ('alpha = -0.10 seems OK'); the Beta dummy (L525) is consequently unused.
INITIAL_N_WAVE: dummy gamma_s (L439, L447) is never used; x2 appears only in the commented general n-wave formula (L490); local tlag (L71 in SOLITARY_WAVE_LEFT_BOUNDARY) likewise assigned but unused.
SUB_SLTRY: zr (L632) is computed but is neither an OUT argument nor used; r1 (L617) and C_ph (L618) receive the identical value rx*cph; local cph shadows the caller's Cph actual argument bound to r1.
INITIAL_GAUSIAN header comment (L251) says input keyword 'INI_REC' although the routine is the gaussian hump (dipole header L340 correctly says 'INI_DIP').
Newton loop failure paths only stop without message: explanatory write commented at L611 (SUB_SLTRY) and L456 (INITIAL_N_WAVE depth guard).
Serial CARTESIAN INITIAL_RECTANGULAR (L231-234) lacks the out-of-window clipping applied in the parallel branch (L220-227); Il<1 or Ir>M would produce an invalid array section.
